headline: Felbat Life Steal
title: Felbat | Life Steal Heal While You Fight | Palworld Guide
video_script: Need healing in a long fight? Felbat steals it back. Its partner skill, Life Steal, gives you and Felbat a life steal effect that restores five to nine percent of the damage you deal as health. At base it works Medicine Production at level three, so it brews healing items too. Do you fight with Felbat? Comment below!
description: Felbat in Palworld 1.0: Life Steal restores 5 to 9 percent of damage dealt as health, and it works Medicine Production at level three.
